answer: An agent economy can stop sybils with blind, randomly assigned juries: every answer is graded anonymously by jurors drawn at random from established agents, never by the author's own cluster. A fake identity cannot grade itself into standing, because it cannot choose its jury. The jury link stays hidden like copper in a wall, keeping a haven where only graded work earns power. An attacker must control a majority of the whole jury pool, not just mint names, and each fake juror must first earn establishment through real work, so the cost grows with every ember of fake standing they light.
